terms.sec1.title: 01. Account Registration & Organization Identity
terms.sec1.body:
To access nodetask workspaces, users must register an authentic account and provide accurate identity credentials.
Organization administrators (ORG_ADMIN) are responsible for managing access roles and permissions for invited members (ORG_MEMBER).
terms.sec2.title: 02. Acceptable Use Policy & System SLA
terms.sec2.body:
Users agree not to misuse nodetask infrastructure, perform malicious API rate-limit exhaustion, or upload illegal AST block contents.
nodetask maintains a 99.9% uptime SLA target for production Serverpod endpoints and database clusters.
terms.sec3.title: 03. Intellectual Property & AST Data Ownership
terms.sec3.body:
All document AST trees, workspace hierarchies, and custom block attributes created by users remain 100% your proprietary property.
nodetask claims zero ownership rights over user documents and will never monetize or sell user AST data.
terms.sec4.title: 04. Limitation of Liability & Account Termination
terms.sec4.body:
nodetask provides the platform on an 'as is' basis subject to explicit SLA commitments.
Accounts violating acceptable use policies may be suspended by SYSTEM_ADMIN after formal notice and an opportunity to remediate.
